Ok my story
After lockdown when school got reopened i was in 7th Standard and like I was studying in that school from nursery so mostly teachers knew me bcz I was topper then in July 3rd July 2022 a new student got admission in our class and unexpectedly he sat in front of my seat and whole day I talked to him his name his dream I get to know everything about him and he was like listening to me didn't said anything only replied in short answer even when his bench mate said to me that why are questioning this much he said let her ask I am the one answering and that was the day I fell in love with him his eyes were the best eyes in whole universe after kanha ji he was the one who's eyes I found attractive..
Then the test came and went we both got the same attention from teachers like all teachers were used to say that these two are only who are studying who are good and there was one teacher of sst who asked us to do notebook checking in her period and that was the only period of our full day where we both sit together have fun and make laugh each other than one day one of his friends told me that in truth and dare he said he has crush on me ( now u will say that his friend broke bro code that's not the thing bcz that guy before becoming his friend was mine friend) and I was like in nine clouds and my bestie who knew my feelings toward him told him everything that I like him than he didn't come on Monday bcz there was his cousin wedding and then the next day we both didn't went bcz i was not feeling well and he was in his cousin's wedding so the next day  when teacher went to mark attendence he asked me about homework and our class saw us talking so she changed our seats saying u both talk too much it is not right and I got scared like what is happening like we both talk each day and she got no problem then what happened now then in next period our next teacher came and our class teacher said to her not let them sit together or talk and the teacher didn't said anything to us and started teaching after that we didn't talked to each other then our second period teacher called me to talk in library alone and she asked me is something going in btw me and that guy I said no we are just friend and all so she said ok that's not problem but from now on u will not talk to him and i went from there I was holding my tears bcz i don't want this to happen then he went to that teacher bcz she asked him also to come and talk to her then my girl classmates started making fun of me they started bullying me like bcz of u he is suffering and all so in 8th standard I changed my section from a to b and in btw this we didn't talk and u will say did anybody didn't said anything to him so I will answer no bcz he had true friend who cared for him and they knew that we are not guilty then everything ended our talking ended our meetings ended then after 8th we both changed to different schools and didn't met till now I am in 11th right now and still i love him I don't know if I will meet him or not but I wanna meet him once I wanna get his glimpses for once which I can store in my heart which is craving for him .....
